abort.already_configured: This FRITZ!Box is already set up.

error.cannot_connect: The FRITZ!Box cannot be reached at this address.
error.insufficient_permissions: The account has no access to the FRITZ!Box settings. Grant the "FRITZ!Box Settings" permission under System > FRITZ!Box Users.
error.no_hosts_service: The FRITZ!Box does not expose the "Hosts" service. Enable "Allow access for applications" under Home Network > Network > Network Settings.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the FRITZ!Box, usually fritz.box.
data_description.username: A FRITZ!Box user with the "FRITZ!Box Settings" permission.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Signing in to {host} failed. Please enter the credentials again.

data_description.track_address_source: This value is not part of the host list and costs one extra request per device. It rarely changes, so it runs on its own slower schedule.
data_description.address_source_interval: Only applies when IP type tracking is enabled.

set_device_name.name: Rename device
set_device_name.description: Changes the name of a network device on the FRITZ!Box.

wake_on_lan.name: Wake device
wake_on_lan.description: Sends a Wake-on-LAN signal to a network device.

set_internet_access.name: Set internet access
set_internet_access.description: Blocks or allows a device's internet access (experimental, only on FRITZ!Boxes with the TR-064 HostFilter service).

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.description: On = block internet access, Off = allow.
